description: Universal Johnny Five contract capability. Installed byte-identically for Pehlichi, Loony-Luna and Mad-Ptah. Contains no agent-specific assumptions: the acting identity is supplied by the caller's capsule at runtime.
invariants: SUBMITTED is a claim, never completion
a worker may never verify its own submission
authorizedBy, performedBy and verifiedBy are distinct and never conflated
replay protection is enforced by the recipient, and a duplicate returns the original result
scope may not be expanded by the worker
every mechanic run is correlated to the work order and service attempt
